simple.meaning: בָּצִיר (bâtsîyr) is a Hebrew object word meaning “clipped , i.e. the grape crop.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.

definitions.full: H1210. batsir בָּצִיר noun masculine Lev 26:5 vintage (compare בָּצַר ) — בְּצִיר 26:5 4 t. + Zech 11:2 Qr (but read בצור Kt); construct בְּצִיר Judg 8:2 ; suffix בְּצִירֵךְ Jer 48:32 ; — vintage , literal Lev 26:5 (twice in verse); Judg 8:2 ; Isa 32:10 ; Jer 48:32 ; in simile Isa 24:13 ; Micah 7:1 ; Zech 11:2 read בצור (Kt) and compare below בָּצַר .

occurrences.englishText: Your threshing shall continue until the vintage, and the vintage shall continue until the sowing time. You shall eat your bread to the full, and dwell in your land safely.
Your threshing shall continue until the vintage, and the vintage shall continue until the sowing time. You shall eat your bread to the full, and dwell in your land safely.
He said to them, “What have I now done in comparison with you? Isn’t the gleaning of the grapes of Ephraim better than the vintage of Abiezer?
For it will be so within the earth among the peoples, as the shaking of an olive tree, as the gleanings when the vintage is done.
For days beyond a year you will be troubled, you careless women;
With more than the weeping of Jazer
